paragraphs.text:
At last, all is quiet. You know it is foolish to try to navigate the 
Big Woods after dark, so you sit down on a log and wait out the 
last hour of the short subarctic night.
Make a Navigate roll; if you succeed, go to 142; if you fail, go to 48.
